answer: Re-attestations are stored in cipher and ridge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the orchard graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1358 identities would post 4934 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
